name: cs-customer-service-policy
description: Writes a customer service policy with one page per topic (hours, channels, response promises, tone, refunds pointer, privacy basics), a change log and a "what we never say" list. Use for "run cs-customer-service-policy", "write our customer service policy", "support standards", "every agent gives a different answer", "one source of truth for support", "customer service guidelines", "service promises", part of the AI for Customer Service Pack by 90n.
